title: Classify an observed EUR battle OBJ list
changes: Identify a separate two-object static OBJ list at 395088 through an original constructor literal and the previously authenticated copied-reader bridge.
validation: Wine e145-battle-residue-wine-3pq4rwye observes reads covering 395088..395096 in one retained battle window. Wine e146-obj-395088-dis-wine-dma7xnd0 shows original 080bdff6 loading the exact list address and 080bdff8 branching through 08145c10 with the constructor pointer from 397f9c; the existing observed-OBJ contract authenticates the copied constructor and six-byte reader stride. The source header has two objects and its 14-byte SHA-256 is c685f8be3478ab57ac1cd59834466c36a155553f5b1ce40933c45a5d932c1459.
limitations: Managed serving and scene equivalence are not yet proved. Other producers, scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
